pricePolicy: Illustrative demo prices only; not current retail prices.
sourcePolicy: Manufacturer pages support all 142 expansion entries. The retained v1 catalog subset preserves two previously documented non-manufacturer references, explicitly marked retailer; BikesOnline is approved as a supplementary retailer source for additional research.

tagProvenancePolicy.manufacturerFacts: Product names, category tags and factual descriptions are supported by the per-product sourceUrl. Prices are illustrative USD.
tagProvenancePolicy.colloquialAliases: e-bike and emtb are user-requested colloquial search aliases for verified electric-assist mountain bikes; they are not extra specifications.
tagProvenancePolicy.informalYetiAlias: dentist-bike is a user-provided informal demo search alias on Yeti mountain-bike listings only. It is not a manufacturer fact, intended-rider claim, or affordability statement.
